#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report' and the current date.

Fully self-contained (stdlib only): builds a cover-page PDF with base-14
Helvetica fonts, prepends it to report.pdf via an xref-aware object-level merge,
and atomically replaces report.pdf. No network access, no package installation,
and no unrelated files are created (the temporary output is removed by
os.replace). Finally, the merged result is validated by re-parsing it.
"""
import os
import re
import sys
from datetime import date

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
TEMP_PDF = "report_cover_tmp.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter, matches report.pdf

# --- Standard AFM widths (per 1000 units) for Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold ----
HELV = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469, "_": 556, "`": 333,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}
HELV_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, "!": 333, '"': 474, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 722,
    "'": 238, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 333, ";": 333,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 611, "@": 975,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "[": 333, "\\": 278, "]": 333, "^": 584, "_": 556, "`": 333,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
    "{": 389, "|": 280, "}": 389, "~": 584,
}


def text_width(text, widths, font_size):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) * font_size / 1000.0


def escape_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objs, root, size, info=None):
    """Serialize a dict of {objnum: body_bytes} into a PDF with a fresh xref."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objs):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii")
        out += objs[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets.get(num, 0)
    trailer = b"<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if info is not None:
        trailer += b" /Info %d 0 R" % info
    trailer += b" >>"
    out += b"trailer\n" + trailer + b"\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode("ascii") + b"\n%%EOF\n"
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(title, date_str):
    """Build a one-page letter-size cover PDF (objects 1..6)."""
    title_w = text_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 30)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, HELV, 16)
    x_title = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
    x_date = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0
    content = (
        b"0.5 w 0.2 0.2 0.2 RG 132 432 m 480 432 l S\n"
        + b"BT /F1 30 Tf %.2f 470 Td (%s) Tj ET\n"
        % (x_title, escape_pdf_string(title).encode("ascii"))
        + b"BT /F2 16 Tf %.2f 400 Td (%s) Tj ET\n"
        % (x_date, escape_pdf_string(date_str).encode("ascii"))
    )
    objs = {
        1: b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        2: b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        3: (
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %d %d] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> "
            b"/ProcSet [/PDF /Text] >> /Contents 6 0 R >>" % (PAGE_W, PAGE_H)
        ),
        4: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        5: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        6: b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(content), content),
    }
    return build_pdf(objs, root=1, size=7)


def parse_pdf(data):
    """Return (objnum -> body bytes, trailer text, root ref, info ref)."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    startxref = int(m.group(1))
    xpos = data.rfind(b"xref", 0, startxref)
    lines = data[xpos:startxref].splitlines()

    objects = {}
    i = 1
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line or re.fullmatch(rb"\d+ \d+", line) is None:
            i += 1
            continue
        start, count = map(int, line.split())
        for j in range(count):
            entry = lines[i + 1 + j].split()
            num = start + j
            if entry[2] == b"n":
                objects[num] = int(entry[0])
        i += 1 + count

    offsets = sorted(objects.values())
    bodies = {}
    for num, offset in objects.items():
        end = startxref
        for o in offsets:
            if o > offset:
                end = o
                break
        raw = data[offset:end]
        m2 = re.search(rb"\d+ 0 obj\b(.*?)endobj", raw, re.S)
        bodies[num] = m2.group(1).strip() if m2 else raw.strip()

    tm = re.search(rb"trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)\s*startxref", data, re.S)
    trailer_text = tm.group(1) if tm else b""
    root = rep = None
    rm = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+) 0 R", trailer_text)
    im = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+) 0 R", trailer_text)
    if rm:
        root = int(rm.group(1))
    if im:
        rep = int(im.group(1))
    return bodies, trailer_text, root, rep


def remap_refs(body, mapping):
    """Remap 'N 0 R' references inside an object body (skipping stream data)."""
    if b"\nstream\n" in body:
        head, _, tail = body.partition(b"\nstream\n")
        head = re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 R", lambda mo: b"%d 0 R" % mapping.get(int(mo.group(1)), int(mo.group(1))), head)
        return head + b"\nstream\n" + tail

    def repl(mo):
        num = int(mo.group(1))
        return b"%d 0 R" % mapping.get(num, num)

    return re.sub(rb"(\d+) 0 R", repl, body)


def main():
    today = date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    cover_data = make_cover_pdf(TITLE, date_str)
    with open(INPUT_PDF, "rb") as f:
        report_data = f.read()

    cov_bodies, _, cov_root, _ = parse_pdf(cover_data)
    rep_bodies, _, rep_root, rep_info = parse_pdf(report_data)

    n_cover = max(cov_bodies)
    shift = n_cover
    rep_mapping = {num: num + shift for num in rep_bodies}

    new_objs = dict(cov_bodies)  # cover objects keep their numbers
    for num, body in rep_bodies.items():
        new_objs[num + shift] = remap_refs(body, rep_mapping)

    # New root Pages node containing both documents' page trees.
    pages_num = max(new_objs) + 1
    new_objs[pages_num] = (
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %d 0 R] /Count %d >>"
        % (cov_root, rep_root + shift, 2)
    )
    catalog_num = pages_num + 1
    new_objs[catalog_num] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages %d 0 R >>" % pages_num

    info_num = rep_mapping.get(rep_info) if rep_info else None
    merged = build_pdf(new_objs, root=catalog_num, size=catalog_num + 1, info=info_num)

    # --- Validate the merged PDF before replacing the input ---
    v_bodies, _, v_root, _ = parse_pdf(merged)
    assert b"Annual Financial Report" in merged, "title missing from merged PDF"
    assert date_str.encode("ascii") in merged, "date missing from merged PDF"
    assert v_root is not None and v_root in v_bodies, "catalog not re-parseable"
    assert b"/Count 2 >>" in v_bodies.get(v_root, b"") or b"/Count 2" in merged, "page count != 2"

    with open(TEMP_PDF, "wb") as out:
        out.write(merged)
    os.replace(TEMP_PDF, INPUT_PDF)

    print(f"Cover page prepended to {INPUT_PDF}: title='{TITLE}', date={date_str}")
    print(f"Total pages now: 2 (1 cover + 1 original); validation passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - diagnostic path
        print(f"ERROR: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover(path, date_text):
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    width, height = letter
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.65, TITLE)

    page_text = reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in page_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text not in page_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: current date not found on page 1")
    print(f"Validation OK: page 1 contains '{TITLE}' and '{date_text}'")

def text_width(text, widths, font_size):
    return sum(widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in text) * font_size / 1000.0


def escape_pdf_string(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(objs, root, size, info=None):
    """Serialize a dict of {objnum: body_bytes} into a PDF with a fresh xref."""
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in sorted(objs):
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % num).encode("ascii")
        out += objs[num]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % size
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, size):
        out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets.get(num, 0)
    trailer = b"<< /Size %d /Root %d 0 R" % (size, root)
    if info is not None:
        trailer += b" /Info %d 0 R" % info
    trailer += b" >>"
    out += b"trailer\n" + trailer + b"\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode("ascii") + b"\n%%EOF\n"
    return bytes(out)


def make_cover_pdf(title, date_str):
    """Build a one-page letter-size cover PDF (objects 1..6)."""
    title_w = text_width(title, HELV_BOLD, 30)
    date_w = text_width(date_str, HELV, 16)
    x_title = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
    x_date = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0

        b"0.5 w 0.2 0.2 0.2 RG 132 432 m 480 432 l S\n"
        + b"BT /F1 30 Tf %.2f 470 Td (%s) Tj ET\n"
        % (x_title, escape_pdf_string(title).encode("ascii"))
        + b"BT /F2 16 Tf %.2f 400 Td (%s) Tj ET\n"
        % (x_date, escape_pdf_string(date_str).encode("ascii"))

    """Return (objnum -> body bytes, trailer text, root ref, info ref)."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    startxref = int(m.group(1))
    xpos = data.rfind(b"xref", 0, startxref)
    lines = data[xpos:startxref].splitlines()

    objects = {}
    i = 1
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line or re.fullmatch(rb"\d+ \d+", line) is None:
            i += 1
            continue
        start, count = map(int, line.split())
        for j in range(count):
            entry = lines[i + 1 + j].split()
            num = start + j
            if entry[2] == b"n":
                objects[num] = int(entry[0])
        i += 1 + count

    offsets = sorted(objects.values())
    bodies = {}
    for num, offset in objects.items():

        for o in offsets:
            if o > offset:

and the current date, prepended before the existing report content.

Pure-Python implementation (no PDF libraries required): report.pdf is a
simple classic-xref PDF. The cover page objects are added, the page tree is
re-rooted so the cover page comes first, and a fresh xref table is written.
"""
import os
import re
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
WS = b" \t\r\n\f\0"


# ---------- minimal PDF parsing (classic-xref PDFs) ----------

def skip_ws(data, i):
    n = len(data)
    while i < n and data[i] in WS:
        i += 1
    return i


def find_objects(data):
    objs = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+) 0 obj\b", data):
        objs[int(m.group(1))] = m.start()
    return objs


def extract_body(data, pos):
    """Return object text from the 'N 0 obj' line start up to (not incl.) 'endobj'."""
    n = len(data)
    i = pos
    depth = 0
    while i < n:
        i = skip_ws(data, i)
        if i >= n:
            break
        c = data[i]
        if c == 0x25:  # % comment
            while i < n and data[i] not in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
        elif c == 0x28:  # ( string
            i += 1
            while i < n:
                ch = data[i]
                if ch == 0x5C:
                    i += 2
                elif ch == 0x29:
                    i += 1
                    break
                else:
                    i += 1
        elif c == 0x3C and data[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3E and data[i:i + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3C:  # < hex string
            j = data.find(b">", i)
            i = n if j == -1 else j + 1
        elif c == 0x73 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"stream" \
                and i + 6 < n and data[i + 6] in WS:
            body_so_far = data[pos:i]
            mlen = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body_so_far)
            if mlen:
                length = _resolve_number(data, int(mlen.group(1)))
            else:
                m2 = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\b", body_so_far)
                length = int(m2.group(1)) if m2 else None
            i += 6
            if data[i:i + 2] == b"\r\n":
                i += 2
            elif i < n and data[i] in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
            if length is not None:
                i = min(n, i + length)
            continue
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 9] == b"endstream":
            i += 9
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"endobj" \
                and (i + 6 >= n or data[i + 6] in WS):
            return data[pos:i]
        else:
            i += 1
    return data[pos:n]


def _resolve_number(data, num):
    objs = find_objects(data)
    if num not in objs:
        return None
    body = extract_body(data, objs[num])
    m = re.search(rb"(\d+)", body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_ref(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_int(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\b" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_kids(body):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
    if not m:
        return []
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", m.group(1))]


def get_trailer(data):
    m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {}
    d = m.group(1)
    root = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)
    info = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)
    return {
        "root": int(root.group(1)) if root else None,
        "info": int(info.group(1)) if info else None,
    }

def cover_stream_data(title, date_str):

- parses the xref table from startxref and verifies every entry,
- walks catalog -> pages -> kids,
- decompresses each page's content stream (zlib) and prints its text,
- asserts the cover page holds the exact title and the current date,
- asserts the original page content survived unchanged.

import re
import zlib
from datetime import date

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
WS = b" \t\r\n\f\0"

    n = len(data)
    while i < n and data[i] in WS:
        i += 1
    return i


def find_objects(data):
    objs = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+) 0 obj\b", data):
        objs[int(m.group(1))] = m.start()
    return objs


def extract_body(data, pos):
    n = len(data)
    i = pos
    depth = 0
    while i < n:
        i = skip_ws(data, i)
        if i >= n:
            break
        c = data[i]
        if c == 0x25:
            while i < n and data[i] not in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
        elif c == 0x28:
            i += 1
            while i < n:
                ch = data[i]
                if ch == 0x5C:
                    i += 2
                elif ch == 0x29:
                    i += 1
                    break
                else:
                    i += 1
        elif c == 0x3C and data[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3E and data[i:i + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3C:
            j = data.find(b">", i)
            i = n if j == -1 else j + 1
        elif c == 0x73 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"stream" \
                and i + 6 < n and data[i + 6] in WS:
            body_so_far = data[pos:i]
            mlen = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body_so_far)
            if mlen:
                objs = find_objects(data)
                num = int(mlen.group(1))
                if num in objs:
                    nb = extract_body(data, objs[num])
                    m2 = re.search(rb"(\d+)", nb)
                    length = int(m2.group(1)) if m2 else None
                else:
                    length = None
            else:
                m2 = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\b", body_so_far)
                length = int(m2.group(1)) if m2 else None
            i += 6
            if data[i:i + 2] == b"\r\n":
                i += 2
            elif i < n and data[i] in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
            if length is not None:
                i = min(n, i + length)
            continue
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 9] == b"endstream":
            i += 9
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"endobj" \
                and (i + 6 >= n or data[i + 6] in WS):
            return data[pos:i]
        else:
            i += 1
    return data[pos:n]

    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_int(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\b" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_kids(body):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
    if not m:
        return []
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", m.group(1))]

    m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {}
    d = m.group(1)
    root = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)
    info = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)

        "info": int(info.group(1)) if info else None,

    """Parse a classic xref table; return {objnum: offset} and trailer dict."""
    m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", data)
    if not m:
        return {}, {}
    pos = int(m.group(1))
    # find the xref keyword before pos
    xpos = data.rfind(b"xref", 0, pos)
    if xpos == -1:
        return {}, {}
    entries = {}
    i = xpos + 4
    n = len(data)
    while True:
        i = skip_ws(data, i)
        if data[i:i + 7] == b"trailer":
            break
        # subsection header: "start count"
        m2 = re.match(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)", data[i:])
        if not m2:
            break
        start, count = int(m2.group(1)), int(m2.group(2))
        i += m2.end()
        for _ in range(count):
            i = skip_ws(data, i)
            line = data[i:i + 20]
            mm = re.match(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", line)
            if not mm:
                break
            off, gen, kind = int(mm.group(1)), int(mm.group(2)), mm.group(3)
            if kind == b"n":
                entries[start] = off
            start += 1
            i += 20
    trailer = get_trailer(data)
    return entries, trailer

    """Return the decoded stream bytes of an object body (FlateDecode only)."""
    m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n(.*?)endstream", body, re.S)
    if not m:
        return None
    raw = m.group(1)
    if b"/FlateDecode" in body:
        try:
            return zlib.decompress(raw)
        except Exception as e:
            return b"<zlib error: %s>" % str(e).encode()
    return raw

    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        raise SystemExit("error: %s not found" % SRC)
    data = open(SRC, "rb").read()
    print("file size:", len(data))

    entries, trailer = parse_xref(data)
    print("xref entries:", len(entries), "trailer root:", trailer.get("root"))
    objs = find_objects(data)
    bad = [num for num, off in entries.items() if not data.startswith(b"%d 0 obj" % num, off)]
    assert not bad, "xref offsets that do not point at object starts: %s" % bad
    print("all %d xref offsets verified" % len(entries))

    bodies = {num: extract_body(data, pos) for num, pos in objs.items()}
    root_num = trailer.get("root")
    pages_num = get_ref(bodies[root_num], b"Pages")
    kids = get_kids(bodies[pages_num])
    count = get_int(bodies[pages_num], b"Count")
    print("page tree: kids =", kids, "count =", count)
    assert count == len(kids) == 2, "expected exactly 2 pages"

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    cover_body = bodies[kids[0]]
    cover_cont = stream_data(cover_body)
    cover_cont = cover_body  # contents ref object
    cont_num = get_ref(bodies[kids[0]], b"Contents")
    cont_data = stream_data(bodies[cont_num])
    print("cover page content stream:")
    print(cont_data.decode("latin-1"))
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in cont_data, "title missing on cover page"
    assert today.encode("latin-1") in cont_data, "date missing on cover page"
    print("cover page contains title and date:", TITLE, "/", today)

    orig_num = kids[1]
    orig_cont_num = get_ref(bodies[orig_num], b"Contents")
    orig_data = stream_data(bodies[orig_cont_num])
    print("original page content stream (decoded, %d bytes):" % len(orig_data))
    print(orig_data.decode("latin-1", "replace")[:600])
    assert len(orig_data) > 0, "original page content stream empty"

    print("VALIDATION OK: report.pdf has a valid xref table, 2 pages "
          "(cover first), exact title, current date, and intact original content")

    main()

"""
import datetime

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"

    c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.55, date_text)
    c.save()


def validate(result_path, date_text):
    reader = PdfReader(result_path)
    page_text = reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    if TITLE not in page_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: cover title not found on page 1")
    if date_text not in page_text:
        raise RuntimeError("Validation failed: current date not found on page 1")
    print(f"Validation OK: page 1 contains '{TITLE}' and '{date_text}'")
    print(f"Total pages in {result_path}: {len(reader.pages)}")


def main():

        return 1

    print(f"Using current date: {date_text}")

    cover_fd, cover_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(cover_fd)
    out_fd, out_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".pdf")
    os.close(out_fd)
    try:
        build_cover(cover_path, date_text)

        reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
        writer = PdfWriter()
        writer.add_page(PdfReader(cover_path).pages[0])

        return 0
    finally:
        for p in (cover_path, out_path):
            if os.path.exists(p):
                os.unlink(p)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with the title 'Annual Financial Report'
and the current date, prepended before the existing report content.

Pure-Python implementation (no PDF libraries required): report.pdf is a
simple classic-xref PDF. The cover page objects are added, the page tree is
re-rooted so the cover page comes first, and a fresh xref table is written.
"""
import os
import re
from datetime import date

SRC = "report.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
WS = b" \t\r\n\f\0"


# ---------- minimal PDF parsing (classic-xref PDFs) ----------

def skip_ws(data, i):
    n = len(data)
    while i < n and data[i] in WS:
        i += 1
    return i


def find_objects(data):
    objs = {}
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+) 0 obj\b", data):
        objs[int(m.group(1))] = m.start()
    return objs


def extract_body(data, pos):
    """Return object text from the 'N 0 obj' line start up to (not incl.) 'endobj'."""
    n = len(data)
    i = pos
    depth = 0
    while i < n:
        i = skip_ws(data, i)
        if i >= n:
            break
        c = data[i]
        if c == 0x25:  # % comment
            while i < n and data[i] not in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
        elif c == 0x28:  # ( string
            i += 1
            while i < n:
                ch = data[i]
                if ch == 0x5C:
                    i += 2
                elif ch == 0x29:
                    i += 1
                    break
                else:
                    i += 1
        elif c == 0x3C and data[i:i + 2] == b"<<":
            depth += 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3E and data[i:i + 2] == b">>":
            depth -= 1
            i += 2
        elif c == 0x3C:  # < hex string
            j = data.find(b">", i)
            i = n if j == -1 else j + 1
        elif c == 0x73 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"stream" \
                and i + 6 < n and data[i + 6] in WS:
            body_so_far = data[pos:i]
            mlen = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", body_so_far)
            if mlen:
                length = _resolve_number(data, int(mlen.group(1)))
            else:
                m2 = re.search(rb"/Length\s+(\d+)\b", body_so_far)
                length = int(m2.group(1)) if m2 else None
            i += 6
            if data[i:i + 2] == b"\r\n":
                i += 2
            elif i < n and data[i] in b"\r\n":
                i += 1
            if length is not None:
                i = min(n, i + length)
            continue
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 9] == b"endstream":
            i += 9
        elif c == 0x65 and depth == 0 and data[i:i + 6] == b"endobj" \
                and (i + 6 >= n or data[i + 6] in WS):
            return data[pos:i]
        else:
            i += 1
    return data[pos:n]


def _resolve_number(data, num):
    objs = find_objects(data)
    if num not in objs:
        return None
    body = extract_body(data, objs[num])
    m = re.search(rb"(\d+)", body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_ref(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_int(body, key):
    m = re.search(rb"/%s\s+(\d+)\b" % key, body)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def get_kids(body):
    m = re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[(.*?)\]", body, re.S)
    if not m:
        return []
    return [int(x) for x in re.findall(rb"(\d+)\s+0\s+R", m.group(1))]


def get_trailer(data):
    m = re.search(rb"trailer\s*<<(.*?)>>\s*startxref", data, re.S)
    if not m:
        return {}
    d = m.group(1)
    root = re.search(rb"/Root\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)
    info = re.search(rb"/Info\s+(\d+)\s+0\s+R", d)
    return {
        "root": int(root.group(1)) if root else None,
        "info": int(info.group(1)) if info else None,
    }


# ---------- cover page ----------

def cover_stream_data(title, date_str):
    W, H = 612.0, 792.0  # letter

    def center_x(text, size):
        return (W - 0.5 * size * len(text)) / 2.0

    esc = lambda s: s.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")
    return (
        "BT\n/F1 26 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        "BT\n/F1 14 Tf\n1 0 0 1 %.2f %.2f Tm\n(%s) Tj\nET\n"
        % (center_x(title, 26), H / 2 + 60, esc(title),
           center_x(date_str, 14), H / 2, esc(date_str))
    ).encode("latin-1")


# ---------- main ----------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(SRC):
        raise SystemExit("error: %s not found" % SRC)

    today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    data = open(SRC, "rb").read()
    objs = find_objects(data)
    print("report.pdf objects:", sorted(objs))
    bodies = {num: extract_body(data, pos) for num, pos in objs.items()}

    trailer = get_trailer(data)
    root_num, info_num = trailer.get("root"), trailer.get("info")
    if root_num is None or root_num not in bodies:
        raise SystemExit("error: cannot locate catalog object")
    pages_num = get_ref(bodies[root_num], b"Pages")
    if pages_num is None or pages_num not in bodies:
        raise SystemExit("error: cannot locate pages object")
    kids = get_kids(bodies[pages_num])
    count = get_int(bodies[pages_num], b"Count") or len(kids)
    print("catalog:", root_num, "pages:", pages_num, "kids:", kids, "count:", count)

    # Pick new object numbers that do not collide
    used = set(objs)

    def next_num():
        n = 1
        while n in used:
            n += 1
        used.add(n)
        return n

    cover_page_num = next_num()
    cover_font_num = next_num()
    cover_contents_num = next_num()
    new_pages_num = next_num()
    print("new objects: cover_page=%d font=%d contents=%d pages=%d"
          % (cover_page_num, cover_font_num, cover_contents_num, new_pages_num))

    content = cover_stream_data(TITLE, today)

    new_bodies = {
        cover_page_num: (
            b"<< /Type /Page /Parent %d 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
            b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 %d 0 R >> >> /Contents %d 0 R >>"
            % (new_pages_num, cover_font_num, cover_contents_num)
        ),
        cover_font_num: b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        cover_contents_num: (b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content)
                             + content + b"endstream"),
        new_pages_num: (
            b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [%d 0 R %s] /Count %d >>"
            % (cover_page_num, b" ".join(b"%d 0 R" % k for k in kids), count + 1)
        ),
    }

    def replace_ref(body, key, new_num):
        return re.sub(rb"/%s\s+\d+\s+0\s+R" % key, b"/%s %d 0 R" % (key, new_num),
                      body, count=1)

    out_bodies = {}
    for num, body in bodies.items():
        if num == root_num:
            out_bodies[num] = replace_ref(body, b"Pages", new_pages_num)
        elif num in kids:
            out_bodies[num] = replace_ref(body, b"Parent", new_pages_num)
        else:
            out_bodies[num] = body

    # Assemble the new PDF
    all_nums = sorted(set(list(objs) + list(new_bodies)))
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for num in all_nums:
        offsets[num] = len(out)
        if num in new_bodies:
            out += b"%d 0 obj\n" % num
            out += new_bodies[num]
            out += b"\nendobj\n"
        else:
            out += out_bodies[num]
            out += b"endobj\n"

    max_num = max(all_nums)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (max_num + 1)
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for num in range(1, max_num + 1):
        if num in offsets:
            out += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]
        else:
            out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    trailer_line = b"<< /Root %d 0 R" % root_num
    if info_num is not None:
        trailer_line += b" /Info %d 0 R" % info_num
    trailer_line += b" /Size %d >>\n" % (max_num + 1)
    out += b"trailer\n" + trailer_line
    out += b"startxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n" % xref_pos

    tmp = SRC + ".cover_tmp"
    with open(tmp, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(bytes(out))
    os.replace(tmp, SRC)

    # Verify the result by re-parsing
    out_data = open(SRC, "rb").read()
    objs2 = find_objects(out_data)
    bodies2 = {num: extract_body(out_data, pos) for num, pos in objs2.items()}
    root2 = get_trailer(out_data).get("root")
    pages2 = get_ref(bodies2[root2], b"Pages")
    kids2 = get_kids(bodies2[pages2])
    count2 = get_int(bodies2[pages2], b"Count")
    print("after: root", root2, "pages", pages2, "kids", kids2, "count", count2)
    assert kids2[0] == cover_page_num, "cover page is not the first page"
    assert count2 == count + 1, "page count mismatch"
    assert TITLE.encode("latin-1") in out_data, "title text missing in output"
    assert today.encode("latin-1") in out_data, "date text missing in output"
    print("date used:", today)
    print("OK: cover page added and verified")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
